snippet.title: Flutterfield - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Flutterfield is a cozy and relaxing idle game. Buy butterflies and raise them in real time, or catch fully grown ones yourself. Unlock, upgrade, and customize habitats while filling your collection with real-life butterfly species!

👉Wishlist on Steam!
